text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: prod-hosted API (route /v2/generate) is seeing a sustained spike in 5xxs and p95 latency. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod-hosted/errors — traces indicate long-running external tool/function calls and structured-output post-processing timeouts.

alex: paging eng-oncall. I'm on it.

maya: looking at tracing now — large tail on tool endpoint calls (avg 2.3s, many >10s). KV cache hit rate unchanged. It looks like some requests are triggering cascaded tool invocations (rerank -> webhook -> extraction) and they're accumulating.

sam: are these coming from a specific customer/route?

maya: mostly from /v2/generate with structured_output enabled and tool_call hints. Top keys: key_abc123, key_free567. Mix of free + standard tiers.

priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) global feature-flag off for tool/function calling 2) restrict structured_output (disable for free tier) 3) emergency per-key rate limits/quota increases. Prefer (1)+(2) for fastest impact.

jordan: agree. We should prefer feature-flag toggle to avoid deploy. LaunchDarkly flag is `enable_tool_calls`. There's also `structured_output_v2` flag.

alex: decision: flip `enable_tool_calls` -> off for hosted tier, and turn `structured_output_v2` -> off for free tier only to reduce blast radius. We'll also push a temporary global per-key rate limit for non-paid keys.

alex: actioning now — issuing LD toggle and calling admin rate-limit API. Will post commands.

alex: (command) `ldctl toggle --flag enable_tool_calls --off --scope hosted`

ops-bot: :gear: LD toggle accepted. Flag `enable_tool_calls` is OFF for scope: hosted.

alex: (command) `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/rate-limit -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scope":"per_key","tier":"free,standard","max_rps":0.5}'`

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Rate limit updated: free+standard max_rps=0.5 across region us/westeu.

maya: I'm seeing error rate drop in the next 60s — p95 down from 4.7s to 1.1s, 5xx rate reduced by ~68%. Good initial signal.

sam: Customer impact note: tool integrations and structured outputs will fail for affected tiers. We should prepare a short status update for status.redwood.io. Priya, can you draft?

priya: yes — small blurb: "We are temporarily restricting external tool/function calls and structured output for some hosted tiers to mitigate an ongoing performance issue. API endpoints remain available for text-only generation. We will update as we have more info." Will post in 5.

jordan: Telemetry check: logs show repeated webhook timeouts with `504 gateway_timeout` to external-tool-host: https://tools.example.com/call — load there spiked at same time. Likely an external vendor degradation amplified by unbounded fan-out.

maya: QoS note: had to evict 2 worker instances that were OOMing due to goroutine pileup handling stuck external calls. Those recovered after flag flip.

alex: On-call handoff: I'm handing to Maya for monitoring window. Handoff at 05:30 UTC. If the error rate stays <2% and latency normalizes for 20m, we'll keep mitigations in place for 2 hours then re-evaluate.

maya: taking handoff. I'll keep an eye and will trigger rollback if error rate increases or customer-critical flows break unexpectedly.

priya: Status page posted: https://status.redwood.io/incidents/176547 — included customer impact and mitigation steps.

sam: Ops note — we should inform support and sentry teams so they can field inbound tickets and identify any regressions from the flags. Also tag customers with webhook retries so they know expected failure modes.

alex: Created support runbook doc snippet (paste):
```
If customer reports missing tool outputs: 1) confirm their tier (free/standard) 2) confirm `enable_tool_calls` flag state 3) suggest disable structured_output in their request as workaround or upgrade to dedicated tier. 4) ETA: monitoring for 2h then controlled re-enable.
```

ops-bot: :bar_chart: Metrics snapshot: 5xx rate from 4.2% -> 1.3% in 5m post-mitigation. Token throughput slightly reduced (-12%).

maya: continuing to monitor traces and tool call queue lengths. If we see backlog reduce to <100 pending across hosts, we'll start a staged re-enable: flip `enable_tool_calls` on for canary customers only (team-owned keys) and observe 10m.

alex: action item (post-incident): add guardrail to runtime — limit fan-out depth to 3 tool calls and add backpressure when external call latency >2s; create ticket ENG-RUNTIME-948.

priya: also propose adding a feature to allow auto-fallback to text-only when structured output times out instead of entirely failing the request. Create ticket PRODUCT-1023.

jordan: root-cause hypothesis: external tool vendor had a partial outage + an adventure prompt caused runaway tool invocation loops for some customers. We'll confirm with logs and the vendor.

maya: 06:00 UTC update: metrics stable. Pending count <60. Re-enable plan: 06:15 -> enable `enable_tool_calls` for canary group (team keys) only.

ops-bot: :gear: LD toggle accepted. `enable_tool_calls` ON for scope: canary-team-keys.

maya: canary run 10m look good (no surge). Next step 06:35 will re-enable for paid tiers only, keep free/standard off.

alex: leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. Handoff complete — Maya is now primary until 08:00 UTC.

priya: I'll assemble incident timeline and impact numbers for postmortem. Initial customer impact: ~2.4k requests failed for tool output across 180 unique keys; top 5 customers accounted for 58% of the traffic.

sam: thanks all. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem and include vendor contact notes.

maya: final note before monitoring-only: please don't flip flags independently — coordinate in this thread or ops channel.

alex: :thumbsup: documented.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigation stable. Closing active paging.

maya: marking thread resolved for active mitigation; keeping thread for postmortem edits."
